description:
The Opportunity Adobe is seeking a Senior IT Product & Delivery Manager to lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of our SAP S/4HANA Core Finance platform. This is a high-impact, AI-intensive leadership role at the intersection of enterprise finance technology and innovative artificial intelligence. You will drive the end-to-end product lifecycle for General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, FICA, Treasury, and adjacent finance systems—while embedding AI and machine learning capabilities to transform how Adobe's finance organization operates. You will collaborate with partners from the finance sector, data scientists, engineering teams, and C-suite customers to deliver intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and self-healing finance workflows. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in SAP S/4HANA. It also demands an entrepreneurial approach to apply the latest advances in generative AI, agentic workflows, and large language models (LLMs) within a world-class finance ecosystem. What You'll Do S/4HANA Product Management Ownership Serve as the primary product owner for S/4HANA Finance components including the General Ledger (Universal Journal), Payables and Receivables, FICA with Contract Accounts and Collections/Dispute Management, Treasury & Cash Management, Revenue Recognition, Revenue Accounting, Fixed Assets, and Cost Center/Profit Center Accounting. Drive configuration, extension build, and integration architecture decisions in collaboration with solution architects and SAP Basis teams. Manage integration touchpoints with Kyriba, Blackline, Databricks, GEP, and custom microservices—ensuring data integrity and real-time financial visibility. • Change agent — proven track record driving organizational adoption of exciting technologies, including managing change management workstreams. • Collaborative builder — skilled at cultivating trusted relationships with finance business owners, SAP, cloud vendors, and internal engineering. Collaborator Engagement & Delivery Leadership • Partner closely with the Director of Global Accounting and Treasury leadership to align technology investments with finance transformation goals. • Write detailed product requirements, AI model cards, functional specs, and user stories consumed by engineering and design teams. • Drive agile ceremonies—sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews—while maintaining a clear line-of-sight from AI experiments to production deployments. • Build executive-ready arguments quantifying return on investment, time-to-value, and risk for AI-enabled initiatives. • Coordinate a cross-functional pod of engineers, QA specialists, finance SMEs, and data engineers. Product Strategy & Technology-Informed Roadmap • Own and evolve the multi-year product roadmap for S/4HANA’s central finance module, prioritizing AI-first capabilities alongside foundational ERP improvements. • Define and champion an AI integration strategy spanning generative AI copilots, intelligent document processing, anomaly detection, and predictive close. • Find opportunities to embed SAP Business AI, Joule, and third-party LLMs (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI) into core finance workflows. • Conduct competitive analysis and stay current on SAP release cycles, AI advancements, and FinTech trends to continuously sharpen the roadmap. AI Feature Delivery & Innovation • Lead delivery of AI-powered capabilities including automated GL account coding and journal entry validation, intelligent AP/AR matching and dispute resolution, natural language querying of financial data via LLM-powered interfaces, predictive cash flow forecasting and working capital optimization, real-time anomaly detection and fraud prevention using ML pipelines. • Partner with Adobe's AI/ML engineering teams and data scientists to design model training datasets, evaluate model performance, and define feedback loops for continuous improvement. • Collaborate with SAP and cloud hyper scalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) to leverage embedded AI services within the S/4HANA digital platform. • Define responsible AI guardrails, bias mitigation frameworks, and explainable standards for all AI models embedded in finance workflows. What you need to succeed • 8+ years of experience in enterprise finance IT, with at least 7 years of hands on SAP S/4HANA or ECC Finance implementations. • Demonstrable experience delivering AI/ML-powered features within ERP or finance platforms (e.g., intelligent automation, NLP interfaces, predictive analytics). • Expert-level knowledge of S/4HANA Finance modules: GL (Universal Journal), AP, AR, FICA, RAR, Treasury, Asset Accounting. • Proven product management or IT delivery leadership track record—driving complex, multi-stakeholder programs from concept to production. • Strong grasp of GAAP, IFRS 15, ASC 606, and subscription business financial models. • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company with subscription revenue models and solid understanding of SAP Order to Cash processes. • Experience integrating SAP S/4HANA analytics (Databricks, SAP Analytics Cloud), procurement (Ariba or GEP or Coupa), and cloud data platforms. Preferred Qualifications • Experience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform), SAP Build, or SAP Extension Suite for custom AI development. • Familiarity with timely engineering, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen) applied to enterprise data. • Knowledge of AI governance frameworks, responsible AI principles, and GDPR/CCPA compliance for finance data managed by automated systems. • Hands-on familiarity with at least one AI/ML toolchain: Azure OpenAI Service, Google’s Vertex AI platform, AWS SageMaker, SAP AI Core, or equivalent. • SAP S/4HANA Finance certification or SAP Activate methodology training. Leadership & Soft Skills • Visionary communicator — able to translate AI/ML concepts and technical architecture to Senior Leadership, Controller, and Board-level audiences. • Strategic operator — comfortable navigating ambiguity, building consensus, and accelerating decisions in a matrixed environment. • Talent multiplier — experience mentoring finance technologists and encouraging a culture of continuous learning and AI literacy. • The Opportunity 

    Adobe is seeking a Senior IT Product & Delivery Manager to lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of our SAP S/4HANA Core Finance platform. This is a high-impact, AI-intensive leadership role at the intersection of enterprise finance technology and innovative artificial intelligence. You will drive the end-to-end product lifecycle for General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, FICA, Treasury, and adjacent finance systems—while embedding AI and machine learning capabilities to transform how Adobe's finance organization operates.

    You will collaborate with partners from the finance sector, data scientists, engineering teams, and C-suite customers to deliver intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and self-healing finance workflows. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in SAP S/4HANA. It also demands an entrepreneurial approach to apply the latest advances in generative AI, agentic workflows, and large language models (LLMs) within a world-class finance ecosystem.

    What You'll Do

  • S/4HANA Product Management Ownership
  • Serve as the primary product owner for S/4HANA Finance components including the General Ledger (Universal Journal), Payables and Receivables, FICA with Contract Accounts and Collections/Dispute Management, Treasury & Cash Management, Revenue Recognition, Revenue Accounting, Fixed Assets, and Cost Center/Profit Center Accounting.
  • Drive configuration, extension build, and integration architecture decisions in collaboration with solution architects and SAP Basis teams.
  • Manage integration touchpoints with Kyriba, Blackline, Databricks, GEP, and custom microservices—ensuring data integrity and real-time financial visibility.

  • • Change agent — proven track record driving organizational adoption of exciting technologies, including managing change management workstreams.

    • Collaborative builder — skilled at cultivating trusted relationships with finance business owners, SAP, cloud vendors, and internal engineering.

    Collaborator Engagement & Delivery Leadership

    • Partner closely with the Director of Global Accounting and Treasury leadership to align technology investments with finance transformation goals.

    • Write detailed product requirements, AI model cards, functional specs, and user stories consumed by engineering and design teams.

    • Drive agile ceremonies—sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews—while maintaining a clear line-of-sight from AI experiments to production deployments.

    • Build executive-ready arguments quantifying return on investment, time-to-value, and risk for AI-enabled initiatives.

    • Coordinate a cross-functional pod of engineers, QA specialists, finance SMEs, and data engineers.

    Product Strategy & Technology-Informed Roadmap

    • Own and evolve the multi-year product roadmap for S/4HANA’s central finance module, prioritizing AI-first capabilities alongside foundational ERP improvements.

    • Define and champion an AI integration strategy spanning generative AI copilots, intelligent document processing, anomaly detection, and predictive close.

    • Find opportunities to embed SAP Business AI, Joule, and third-party LLMs (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI) into core finance workflows.

    • Conduct competitive analysis and stay current on SAP release cycles, AI advancements, and FinTech trends to continuously sharpen the roadmap.

    AI Feature Delivery & Innovation

    • Lead delivery of AI-powered capabilities including automated GL account coding and journal entry validation, intelligent AP/AR matching and dispute resolution, natural language querying of financial data via LLM-powered interfaces, predictive cash flow forecasting and working capital optimization, real-time anomaly detection and fraud prevention using ML pipelines.

    • Partner with Adobe's AI/ML engineering teams and data scientists to design model training datasets, evaluate model performance, and define feedback loops for continuous improvement.

    • Collaborate with SAP and cloud hyper scalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) to leverage embedded AI services within the S/4HANA digital platform.

    • Define responsible AI guardrails, bias mitigation frameworks, and explainable standards for all AI models embedded in finance workflows.

    What you need to succeed

    • 8+ years of experience in enterprise finance IT, with at least 7 years of hands on SAP S/4HANA or ECC Finance implementations.

    • Demonstrable experience delivering AI/ML-powered features within ERP or finance platforms (e.g., intelligent automation, NLP interfaces, predictive analytics).

    • Expert-level knowledge of S/4HANA Finance modules: GL (Universal Journal), AP, AR, FICA, RAR, Treasury, Asset Accounting.

    • Proven product management or IT delivery leadership track record—driving complex, multi-stakeholder programs from concept to production.

    • Strong grasp of GAAP, IFRS 15, ASC 606, and subscription business financial models.

    • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company with subscription revenue models and solid understanding of SAP Order to Cash processes.

    • Experience integrating SAP S/4HANA analytics (Databricks, SAP Analytics Cloud), procurement (Ariba or GEP or Coupa), and cloud data platforms.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform), SAP Build, or SAP Extension Suite for custom AI development.

    • Familiarity with timely engineering, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen) applied to enterprise data.

    • Knowledge of AI governance frameworks, responsible AI principles, and GDPR/CCPA compliance for finance data managed by automated systems.

    • Hands-on familiarity with at least one AI/ML toolchain: Azure OpenAI Service, Google’s Vertex AI platform, AWS SageMaker, SAP AI Core, or equivalent.

    • SAP S/4HANA Finance certification or SAP Activate methodology training.

    Leadership & Soft Skills

    • Visionary communicator — able to translate AI/ML concepts and technical architecture to Senior Leadership, Controller, and Board-level audiences.

    • Strategic operator — comfortable navigating ambiguity, building consensus, and accelerating decisions in a matrixed environment.

    • Talent multiplier — experience mentoring finance technologists and encouraging a culture of continuous learning and AI literacy.

  • Strong comprehension of sales pipeline oversight, sales performance tracking, and forecasting procedures
  • Strong experience partnering with engineering, architecture, and operations teams in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Experience managing complex, multi-system initiatives through disciplined prioritization and execution
  • Strong data and analytical abilities with experience working on data models, pipelines, and forecasting inputs

Cross-Functional Leadership & Alignment

  • Comfortable presenting to and influencing senior leadership and governance forums (e.g., PRB/ARB)

Analytical & Problem-Solving

  • Strong capability to detect problems in data, process, or system build
  • Experience using data to drive product decisions, prioritization, and continuous improvement

Execution & Operational Excellence

title: Internal Product Manager 3 - Sales Performance Management

description:
Principal Product Manager Order to Cash Platform (SAP BRIM) Location: San Jose, CA Our Company Adobe is changing the world through digital experiences. We empower everyone - from emerging artists to global brands - to create and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We are passionate about building innovative products that transform how businesses engage with their customers. The Opportunity Adobe is seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and modernization of our Order-to-Cash (O2C) platform powered by SAP BRIM. This highly visible role is responsible for defining the future of Adobe's monetization platform, supporting both B2B and B2C business models across subscriptions, usage-based offerings, digital commerce, and enterprise licensing. As a Principal Product Manager, you will own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for critical Order to Cash (OTC) capabilities. You will partner closely with Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Legal, and Tax teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities that support Adobe's evolving business needs. The ideal candidate combines deep O2C domain expertise with strong Product Management fundamentals and SAP BRIM experience. You have successfully owned enterprise platform strategy, prioritized roadmap investments, driven measurable business outcomes, and influenced senior stakeholders in complex cross-functional environments. Who You Are You are a product leader who thinks beyond system implementation and focuses on solving business problems through scalable platform capabilities. You have experience owning product strategy and roadmaps for enterprise platforms and understand how monetization, billing, revenue management, and financial processes work together to support business growth. You are comfortable partnering with engineering teams on technical tradeoffs, collaborating with business stakeholders on priorities, and influencing executive leaders through data-driven recommendations and clear product strategy. What You'll Do Product Strategy & Roadmap Define and own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Adobe's O2C platform. Identify opportunities to improve scalability, operational efficiency, compliance, and customer experience across the monetization ecosystem. Prioritize platform investments based on business value, customer impact, operational needs, and technical feasibility. Influence executive stakeholders and partner with business leaders to align roadmap priorities with Adobe's strategic objectives. Establish success metrics, KPIs, and outcome-based measures to evaluate product investments and platform performance. Product Management & Execution Own product requirements, backlog prioritization, roadmap planning, and delivery for key OTC capabilities. Translate complex business needs into clear product requirements, epics, user stories, and product decisions. Drive product discovery, solution evaluation, and business case development for strategic initiatives. Make prioritization decisions by balancing business value, customer needs, technical complexity, and operational impact. Partner closely with engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle to ensure successful execution and delivery. OTC Transformation Lead product strategy and cross-functional execution for strategic OTC transformation initiatives. Drive modernization efforts that support Adobe's evolving monetization models and operational requirements. Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering teams to define future-state platform capabilities and scalable solution approaches. Support ERP modernization initiatives, including SAP S/4HANA and SAP RISE transformations, ensuring alignment with Adobe's OTC strategy. full_job_description_raw:
Principal Product Manager Order to Cash Platform (SAP BRIM)

Location: San Jose, CA

Our Company

Adobe is changing the world through digital experiences. We empower everyone - from emerging artists to global brands - to create and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We are passionate about building innovative products that transform how businesses engage with their customers.

The Opportunity

Adobe is seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and modernization of our Order-to-Cash (O2C) platform powered by SAP BRIM. This highly visible role is responsible for defining the future of Adobe's monetization platform, supporting both B2B and B2C business models across subscriptions, usage-based offerings, digital commerce, and enterprise licensing.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for critical Order to Cash (OTC) capabilities. You will partner closely with Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Legal, and Tax teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities that support Adobe's evolving business needs.

The ideal candidate combines deep O2C domain expertise with strong Product Management fundamentals and SAP BRIM experience. You have successfully owned enterprise platform strategy, prioritized roadmap investments, driven measurable business outcomes, and influenced senior stakeholders in complex cross-functional environments.

Who You Are

You are a product leader who thinks beyond system implementation and focuses on solving business problems through scalable platform capabilities.

You have experience owning product strategy and roadmaps for enterprise platforms and understand how monetization, billing, revenue management, and financial processes work together to support business growth.

You are comfortable partnering with engineering teams on technical tradeoffs, collaborating with business stakeholders on priorities, and influencing executive leaders through data-driven recommendations and clear product strategy.

What You'll Do

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Adobe's O2C platform.
  • Identify opportunities to improve scalability, operational efficiency, compliance, and customer experience across the monetization ecosystem.
  • Prioritize platform investments based on business value, customer impact, operational needs, and technical feasibility.
  • Influence executive stakeholders and partner with business leaders to align roadmap priorities with Adobe's strategic objectives.
  • Establish success metrics, KPIs, and outcome-based measures to evaluate product investments and platform performance.

Product Management & Execution

  • Own product requirements, backlog prioritization, roadmap planning, and delivery for key OTC capabilities.
  • Translate complex business needs into clear product requirements, epics, user stories, and product decisions.
  • Drive product discovery, solution evaluation, and business case development for strategic initiatives.
  • Make prioritization decisions by balancing business value, customer needs, technical complexity, and operational impact.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle to ensure successful execution and delivery.

OTC Transformation

  • Lead product strategy and cross-functional execution for strategic OTC transformation initiatives.
  • Drive modernization efforts that support Adobe's evolving monetization models and operational requirements.
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering teams to define future-state platform capabilities and scalable solution approaches.
  • Support ERP modernization initiatives, including SAP S/4HANA and SAP RISE transformations, ensuring alignment with Adobe's OTC strategy.
  • Ensure solutions support subscriptions, recurring revenue, usage-based billing, digital commerce, and enterprise licensing business models.

SAP BRIM Product Ownership

Provide product leadership across SAP BRIM capabilities including:

  • Subscription Order Management (SOM)
  • Convergent Charging (CC)
  • Convergent Invoicing (CI)
  • Financial Contract Accounting (FICA)
  • Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR)
  • SAP S/4HANA integrations

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Legal, Tax, Engineering, and Enterprise Architecture teams to define and deliver business capabilities.
  • Influence and align stakeholders across multiple organizations and leadership levels.
  • Communicate product strategy, roadmap priorities, tradeoffs, and outcomes to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Build consensus across competing priorities while maintaining focus on long-term platform objectives and business outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of experience in Product Management, Enterprise Platforms, Business Systems, OTC, Billing, Revenue Management, or related domains.
  • 5+ years of Product Management experience with ownership of product strategy, roadmap, and delivery.
  • Experience owning the strategy and roadmap for enterprise, OTC, billing, revenue management, or monetization platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and business outcomes for enterprise business platforms.
  • Proven track record of making product investment decisions and prioritization tradeoffs across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Experience serving as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or Platform Product Leader - not solely as a SAP BRIM functional lead, implementation consultant, solution architect, systems analyst, or program manager.
  • At least one end-to-end SAP BRIM implementation supporting both B2B and B2C business models.
  • Experience participating in or leading SAP ERP modernization programs, including SAP S/4HANA and SAP RISE transformations, with a strong understanding of impacts to O2C, Revenue Management, Finance, and SAP BRIM ecosystems.
  • Deep understanding of subscription commerce, recurring revenue, usage-based billing, invoicing, collections, revenue management, and monetization processes.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
  • Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and drive organizational alignment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep expertise across SAP BRIM modules including SOM, CC, CI, FICA, and RAR.
  • Strong understanding of SAP SD and SAP Finance/FICO.
  • Experience working within SaaS, Software, Digital Media, or Technology companies.
  • Experience defining future-state platform capabilities and partnering with architecture teams on modernization initiatives.
  • Proven ability to identify business problems, define product vision, evaluate tradeoffs, and make strategic platform recommendations.
  • Experience defining and tracking KPIs, operational metrics, and business outcomes for enterprise platforms.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience operating within Agile product development environments and collaborating closely with engineering teams.

Success in This Role

Within your first year, you will:

  • Establish and execute a multi-year roadmap for Adobe's SAP BRIM-powered OTC platform.
  • Deliver strategic platform enhancements that improve scalability, reliability, operational efficiency, and business agility.
  • Drive successful modernization initiatives supporting Adobe's monetization and ERP transformation objectives.
  • Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Legal, and Tax organizations.
  • Deliver measurable improvements across billing, invoicing, revenue management, and monetization capabilities.
  • Help influence the future direction of Adobe's O2C platform and monetization ecosystem.

Why Adobe

At Adobe, you'll work on some of the most complex monetization and business platform challenges in the industry. You'll have the opportunity to shape platform strategy, drive transformative initiatives, and help build the systems that power Adobe's global business.

This role offers the chance to influence critical business capabilities, partner with leaders across the company, and deliver solutions that support millions of customers worldwide.


About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.


Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. Sr Product Manager – Sales Data and Analytics- San Jose

The Opportunity 

The Sr. Product Manager for Sales & Post Sales Data & Analytics will drive prioritization, planning, and execution of enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions. The candidate is passionate about Sales Data Management, Sales processes, , and the people that use them! This individual will work with internal stakeholders across Sales, Operations, and Strategy to gather and prioritize critical business requirements in support of the Sales Data and Analytics technology roadmap and vision in collaboration with other Product Managers across Sales & Post Sales platforms. This person will also partner with System Analysts and Development teams to design, develop, and deliver business capability solutions that provide accuracy, value, and exceptional user experiences.

What you’ll do 

  • Partner with the business to deliver and enable self-service data and insights tools to allow them to make better and quicker data-driven decisions.
  • Serve as product management liaison to data and analytics engineering teams.
  • Contribute to product strategy and vision for the Information and Data Services team. Build working relationships with partners to understand their data analytics needs and priorities, clarify objectives, and communicate plans.
  • Review and transform customer analytics needs into defined data engineering requirements, features, and enhancements. 
  • Prioritize and lead end-to-end delivery of data solutions that integrate batched and streaming data sources.
  • Leverage Adobe’s strategic data assets to deliver trusted insights that drive business outcomes, promoting our data-driven decision-making culture.
  • Perform regular data querying and analysis for applied data analytic insights, customer engagement, predictions, and recommendation solutions. 
  • Collaborate with other Product Managers to deliver interdependent solutions and initiatives. 
  • Maintain and prioritize the product backlog and manage competing requests from stakeholders and user groups.
  • Support sprint planning and other scrum events as the Product Owner

What You Need to Succeed 

  • Requires bachelor's degree. Preferred candidates will have a degree in one of computer science, computer engineering, data science, information systems, or equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in data analytics, 'data BSA,' or data product management with a solid understanding of delivering data solutions in an agile environment.
  • Strong SQL/SparkSQL/Python proficiency in querying and manipulating large data sets. Experience with platforms like Databricks, Power BI, and Tableau. 
  • You are a self-starter, independent, hard worker with high motivation to go above and beyond the task at hand. You anticipate and creatively implement the next steps in a complex environment.
  • You have mastered the ability to influence outcomes, navigate, and mediate to consensus with integrity. You possess excellent interpersonal communication, presentation skills, and social skills.
  • Data requirement writing skills: collecting, prioritizing, and gathering input from multiple sources, providing accurate requirements with attention to detail.
  • You already know or can rapidly learn enterprise application capabilities to deliver transaction and event-driven data solutions (examples: SAP/HANA, MS Dynamics Data, ADLS/Hadoop/SQL Server /Databricks data lake/lakehouse solutions, and Kafka streams).
